cross_check_source.result: All 30 win-loss records match the primary source exactly on 2026-11-13.

close_w+close_l+blowout_w+blowout_l <= w+l for all teams (FAIL - recomputed 2026-11-14: 18 of 30 teams violate it: ATL, CHA, CHI, DAL, DEN, DET, HOU, LAC, MEM, MIA, MIL, MIN, OKC, POR, SAC, SAS, TOR, WAS - a team shows more close+blowout games than it played)

corrections.what_changed: The four internal_consistency_checks strings and the FLAG-RAT-02 issue text were recomputed and were WRONG as written.

corrections.original_flag_rat_02_issue: Close-game and blowout-game split columns do not balance league-wide (wins total must equal losses total). The discrepancy arises from the text extraction of the source table (some rows have blank/merged cells), not necessarily from the source itself. These columns are therefore NOT used for any model parameter.
corrections.why_it_matters: The original text claimed the split columns did not balance league-wide, which would have excluded them for the wrong reason, and it claimed a per-team bound holds that 18 clubs violate. The corrected statement gives the true reason: the per-team split contradicts the games played.

flags.issue: Point-level season rates (PS/G, PA/G, SRS) could not be retrieved from an official NBA.com endpoint in this session: stats.nba.com is unreachable from the tooling and nba.com/stats tables are client-rendered. Values are third-party sourced and require one-time manual confirmation against the official NBA.com standings 'Margins & Stats' section.
flags.action_required: Confirm PS/G, PA/G and rating values at https://www.nba.com/standings (Section: Margins & Stats) and at https://www.nba.com/stats/team/<team_id>.

flags.issue: The close-game and blowout-game split columns are internally inconsistent AT THE TEAM LEVEL: for 18 of the 30 clubs the close and blowout rows together account for more games than the club has played (ATL shows 13 close+blowout games in a 12-game record, MEM 12 in 11, DET 12 in 11). The league-wide sums DO balance (close 99=99, blowout 88=88), so a league-level check alone would have passed - the check has to be per team. These columns are therefore NOT used for any model parameter and are left blank in the luck table: a split that contradicts the games played cannot support a per-team luck claim. The cause is the text extraction of the source table (blank/merged cells), not necessarily the source itself.
flags.action_required: Re-extract the close/blowout columns from the source table row by row, or drop them from the snapshot. Do not publish them until every club satisfies close+blowout <= games played.
